    Start on your iPhone

    1. Open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Launch from that icon.
    2. In My materials, import 001-300.pdf, 301-600.pdf, 601-614.pdf, and your L001-LESSON.mp3 recordings. You can start with lessons 1–3.
    3. Choose your lesson and follow each step. Your place saves automatically.
    4. Wait for “App available offline”, then try reopening in Airplane Mode.

    The prepared pages apply to the supplied book, as one PDF or three parts. Sentence cuts apply to the original recordings. Some sentence cuts are drafts; a short message identifies those during shadowing. Use the audio controls to pause manually if a cut needs adjusting.

    Safari tabs and Home Screen apps may have separate storage. Import inside the app you plan to use.
